title: coding-study AI review document
description: `cstudy ai review --json` and `cstudy ai review --show ID --json`: one AI review of a rubric problem's notes. The record's fields are a public record, additive only (docs/specs/ai.md#the-record); `notes_changed` is read when the document is written. Spec: docs/specs/cli.md#cstudy-ai-review

review_id.description: The review's id, which `--show` and `--dismiss` take

attempt_id.description: The attempt whose notes were reviewed

format.description: The record's format, 1; a later format is a new value

rubric_sha256.description: The rubric version: the SHA-256 of rubric.md as reviewed against

notes_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the notes reviewed

notes_changed.description: Whether the attempt's notes differ now from the notes reviewed; null when they are gone

criteria.description: One entry per rubric criterion, in rubric order, with its text as it was reviewed

summary.description: Strengths, then the most important gaps; at most 800 characters

quotes_dropped.description: Quotes the model gave that the notes do not hold, dropped

input_tokens.description: As the provider reported them; null without a report

cost_usd.description: As the provider reported it, in US dollars; null when it reported none

dismissed_at.description: When you dismissed it, or null

number.description: n of the criterion's id `Cn`, counted across the areas in order

evidence.description: Quotes from the notes that the verdict rests on, each found in them

gaps.description: What the answer lacks for the criterion; empty when it is met
